dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Saints (3-7) Week 12 Briefing: Wednesday Injury Report Ahead of Bengals
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: OT Taliese Fuaga (knee), C Erik McCoy (biceps), and OT Asim Richards (knee) logged limited practice reps Wednesday [neworleanssaints.com Official](https://www.neworleanssaints.com/news/new-orleans-saints-center-erik-mccoy-right-tackle-taliese-fuaga-return-to-practice-on-limited-basis-after-missing-last-two-games). TE Juwan Johnson (hamstring, wrist) did not practice Wednesday, while CB Martin Emerson Jr. (concussion) practiced in full [neworleanssaints.com Official](https://www.neworleanssaints.com/news/injury-report-cincinnati-bengals-vs-new-orleans-saints-2026-nfl-week-12-wednesday).

Week 12 Bengals Outlook: Kellen Moore and DC Brandon Staley open installation for the Cincinnati Bengals (7-3, CIN -10, HC Zac Taylor, OC Dan Pitcher & DC Al Golden (Road Test))—a unit ranked #1 in Passing Yards / Game (297.1 yds) as New Orleans prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [Tina Howell](https://www.canalstreetchronicles.com/new-orleans-saints-injuries/118542/wednesdays-saints-vs-bengals-injury-report-erik-mc-coy-and-taliese-fuaga-return-to-practice) [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873087).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 3-7 (3rd in NFC South • #14 Seed in NFC), New Orleans carries a 8.1% postseason projection, 8% NFC South division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [NFL Trade Rumors](https://nfltraderumors.co/nfc-notes-tyler-shough-kellen-moore-buccaneers-panthers-saints/).

Around the Beat: Werner was held out of the Saints' Week 11 loss to the Bears due to a hamstring injury that he sustained against the Panthers in Week 10 [Jeff Nowak](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4241993/pete-werner#:~:text=Werner%20%28hamstring%29%20was%20a%20limited%20participant%20in).
